summary: Iteration 3 testing complete. All 69 backend tests passed (28 iter1 + 13 iter2 + 28 new offers tests). Frontend UI testing verified Offers page, New Offer modal with live GST preview, type badges, Convert to Project flow, and Project Detail Linked Offer card.
critical_code_review_comments: Offers CRUD endpoints working correctly with proper GST calculations (base * gst_percent / 100)
effective_type logic correct: uses custom_type when offer_type is 'Other', else uses offer_type
Convert-to-project creates project with quoted_amount = offer.total_amount (GST inclusive)
Project linkage fields (offer_id, offer_code, offer_type, offer_file_path) properly populated
Dashboard stats includes total_offers and pending_offers counts
Update offer syncs offer_type and file_path to linked project
Delete offer clears linkage on project (sets offer_id=null, offer_code='', etc.)
Frontend type badges use correct colors (RCC blue, Steel gray, Audit yellow, PMC purple, custom green)
Live GST preview in modal updates correctly as user types
Convert button only shown on Pending offers, hidden on Accepted/Rejected
Linked Offer card on Project Detail page shows offer code, type, and file path with Copy button
seed_data_creation: 3 offers seeded on startup: OFR-0001 Audit (28000 base, 33040 total, Mrs. Husna Ara Sayed), OFR-0002 Steel (200000 base, 236000 total, Rohan Enterprises), OFR-0003 PMC as 'Other' custom type (150000 base, 177000 total, Sunrise Developers). OFR-0001 was converted to project CC-0054.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 Offers module fully tested. New test file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3_offers.py covers: Offers list with filtering (status, search), GST calculation verification, effective_type logic, Offers CRUD (create, read, update, delete), Convert-to-project (creates project, marks offer Accepted, links both), Project offer linkage fields, Update offer syncs to project, Delete offer clears project linkage, Dashboard stats with offer counts, No MongoDB _id in responses, Seeded offers verification. Frontend tested: Offers page with filter tabs (All/Pending/Accepted/Rejected), search, New Offer modal with all fields and live GST preview, type badges with colors, Convert button visibility logic, Copy file path button, Project Detail Linked Offer card with file path and Copy button.
